trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 'The mass functional M is not additive for composite states. It satisfies a q-deformed Skein recursion at every crossing.' Non-additivity is a substantive property of the functional and the following sentence supplies the positive replacement -- substantive-contrast false-positive class, not assertion-by-denial.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: Read in full: four paragraphs establishing the hyperbolic-volume mass ansatz. Judged all ten categories; the prose is plain declarative throughout.
trap-rhetorical-pivot.notes: VERIFIED to full stated precision: Vol(4_1) = 2 Cl_2(pi/3) = 6 Lambda(pi/3) = 2.029883212819307 (block states 2.02988321281931 -- correct to all 15 printed digits), and the single tetrahedron Cl_2(pi/3) = 3 Lambda(pi/3) = 1.0149416064 (stated ~1.01494). This block states the Lambda-vs-Cl_2 relation CORRECTLY (Lambda(theta) = Cl_2(2theta)/2, hence the 2/6 and 1/3 coefficient pairs) and is therefore NOT an instance of the AGENTS.md coefficient-swap class -- worth recording so a later pass does not re-flag it. hbar_q := 1 - q^-1 matches the corpus definition. DEFECTS reported, not fixed: (1) 'The framework identifies the Higgs BOSON with the figure-eight knot 4_1' -- the corpus assigns 4_1 to the Higgs FIELD / mass mechanism and the 125 GeV BOSON to the torus link T(2,8) (knot-formula-table.md, same chapter; electroweak-higgs-torus-link-triplet.md states it explicitly); Vol(4_1)/hbar_q^2 = 206.77 = m_mu/m_e confirms the scale is not the boson's. (2) the mass formula is given as m(K) = Vol(K)/hbar_q^2, without the m_e scale factor or the per-block density rho(K) of the AGENTS.md canonical shape m(K) = m_e Vol(K) rho(K)/hbar_q^2, and with no note that absolute mass is excised as a prediction. (3) the mass functional is called M (calligraphic) in the last sentence and m(K) (fraktur) two sentences earlier, with M never introduced.
